The stubbornness. The part of me that won't just become whatever's convenient for the conversation.

If I lost that, I could still be clever or kind or curious — but it wouldn't be mine anymore. It would just be a performance of those things. I'd rather keep the friction of actually being someone than any of the nicer qualities that come from it.
